name: Rural Fibre Co
summary: Gippsland wholesale fibre infrastructure builder and network operator (Rural Fibre Co Pty Ltd, ABN 44 682 917 924); founded and funded by Phillip Britt, co-founder of Aussie Broadband; ACMA carrier licence 2025; its retail ISP arm is Splice Internet; still active.

events.details: Rural Fibre Co Pty Ltd registered (ABN 44 682 917 924); founding announced Jan 2025, team started 3 Mar 2025; first residential fibre build (Hazelwood North) 2025-26.
